items.headline: OpenAI ARR near $50B at Sept-end per Bloomberg/FT, vs Axios' Sept 29 scoop of nearly $70B; firm targets $70B by year-end
items.why: Gap reflects investor-relations methodology dispute vs Anthropic comps; bears on IPO/valuation credibility and burn-vs-growth narrative

items.headline: Fed minutes show officials expect another rate hike by year-end despite holding at 3.75%-4%
items.why: Signals Fed isn't done tightening; markets had leaned toward a dovish pause, forcing repricing of rate-cut/hike odds.

items.headline: Paramount completes ~$110B acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, forming a major studio/streaming conglomerate
items.why: One of the largest media M&A deals ever; reshapes the studio, streaming and cable-news competitive landscape.

items.headline: Schneider Electric to acquire industrial-software firm PTC for ~$23.7B enterprise value
items.why: Largest industrial-software deal of the year; part of broader AI-driven consolidation in enterprise/industrial software.

items.headline: China's State Council unveils modest stimulus package, moves to stabilize property market after growth slips below 2026 target
items.why: Signals Beijing's official growth target is at risk; stimulus scope seen as a 'nudge not a game-changer,' disappointing markets hoping for bigger support

items.headline: Bloomberg: Nvidia faces scrutiny over AI chips reaching China via Southeast Asia smuggling schemes despite export curbs
items.why: Highlights enforcement gaps in US chip export controls and political pressure on Nvidia's China exposure

items.headline: PBOC cuts policy-bank lending rate (PSL) to 1.5% from 1.75%, rolls out targeted liquidity support
items.why: Signals Beijing favoring precision easing over broad stimulus as growth cools toward the lower end of its 4.5-5% target.

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B at a $1.4T valuation ahead of a planned 2027 IPO
items.why: Would be among the largest-ever private valuations; tests investor appetite amid scrutiny of OpenAI's compute/debt load.

items.headline: Anthropic tells investors its annualized revenue run rate climbed to $65B in July 2026
items.why: Rapid ARR growth underpins pre-IPO valuation push and intensifies competitive pressure on OpenAI/enterprise AI spend
